request.eligibility: only existing unlocked ultimate; request while cooldown/CP blocked shows reason; do not consume CP until legal cast start
request.persistence: one pending intent per actor, replace only on explicit user selection, cancel manually/death/battle end; no automatic expiry or silent substitution
request.target: AI resolves legal target at commit, no alternate ultimate

priority: explicit ultimate request or legal prerequisite
damage/utility by effective value per CP and time
scheduler.reservation: only pending user request reserves CP; reserve exact final cost plus necessary legally requested form activation cost if both paid; do not auto trigger manual form/ultimate; manual form request separately; survival override only when projected lethal; retain pending and show reason
scheduler.no_pending: dynamic auto CP budget for normal skills; default soft floor 20% max CP, spend above floor or high benefit, use basic and regen until sufficient; 20% DEV candidate not tuned
scheduler.target: validate range/LOS/ground/mark/form and snapshot before committing; no stale cached target; don't auto spend on immune or already capped effect
scheduler.anti_starvation: track time since eligible meaningful use; after two ready cooldown periods add bounded priority only for meaningful, affordable, legal effects; never bypass caps or manual intent
scheduler.cp: fixed-point 100 units/CP, reserve not debit; actual paid once at commit, existing refund policy, clamp return to missing CP and appropriate parent cost
scheduler.cooldown: preserve existing authored start/interrupt policy until explicitly agreed; no hidden recharge from queue
